tokens: index.html (:root and the Lemon theme block)
assets: index.html (brandmark, hero mascot, page mascots, empty-state head)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Paper. Page background, header and nav bar, and the fill inside the mascot's body.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card, KPI card, input and modal surface.

tokens.name: panel2
tokens.usage: Recessed paper inside a card.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Fill of grey pills, chips, position badges and table group rows.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Lemon. The one colour: dashboard hero, active bottom tab, refresh button, START label, selected search result, focus glow, mascot details. Ink on lemon is 15.6:1.

tokens.name: pop-soft
tokens.usage: Pale lemon: hover fill on cards, rows and ghost buttons; the user's own rows in tables.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Ink outline, 1.5px, on every card, control and illustration.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between table rows and on quiet surfaces (stat tiles, player rows). Decorative only, 1.33:1 on panel.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text and numbers on bg, panel and pop (17.4:1 on bg); also the fill of primary buttons and the active tab.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, handwritten asides and table heads on bg, panel, chip and pop (5.96:1 on chip).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Winning or positive values, leading categories (5.32:1 on panel, 4.59:1 on good-bg).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution text (5.65:1 on panel, 5.0:1 on warn-bg).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: SIT label, trailing categories, injury count, remove buttons (5.2:1 on panel). On bad-bg it is 4.34:1, just below AA, so keep it bold there.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind good text, e.g. a winning H2H input.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and hover of remove buttons.

tokens.name: err-text
tokens.usage: Error banner text on bad-bg (6.58:1).

tokens.name: series-b
tokens.usage: Chart series B (the comparison player); series A is text. Marks only, never text (2.29:1).

tokens.name: pct-fair
tokens.usage: Percentile 60–79 step on single-colour percentile bars. Marks only.

tokens.name: hand-l
tokens.usage: Left-handed pitcher chip text (4.5:1 on chip).

tokens.name: hand-r
tokens.usage: Right-handed pitcher chip text (4.51:1 on chip).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop.

families.display: Anton, "Arial Narrow", Impact, "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif
families.head: "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", PMingLiU, serif

styles.name: hero-num
